listings.d: MASS MOBILE RV SERVICE LLC. is a female and veteran owned mobile RV repair business servicing Eastern Massachusetts east of I-495 and Cape Cod. It brings the shop to the RV and handles electrical, plumbing, propane diagnostics and repair, heat and A/C repairs, refrigeration, winterizing and de-winterizing, routine maintenance, pre-delivery inspections, new owner orientations and roof damage repair. It is a certified distributor and installer for Blaze Cut automatic fire suppression systems, is fully licensed and insured, and states it does not perform exterior body damage repairs or interior cleaning.

listings.d: TRIC Mobile RV Repair is a family-owned on-site RV service serving Central Massachusetts, Northern Rhode Island and Northern Connecticut. Owner and lead technician Ryan Hadley is an RVTI Certified Technician and an RV PRO Top 40 Under 40 recipient. Repairs cover water heaters, furnaces, trailer brakes and wheel bearings, appliances, roof leaks, awnings and plumbing, along with winterization, maintenance and Sealtech leak detection. listings.d: RV Master Tech is a Cape Cod-based mobile RV service owned and operated by Jason Fitzgerald, an RVTI Level 4 Master Certified Technician and RVTAA Master Certified Technician with over nine years of experience. It brings repair, maintenance and upgrades to the customer's home, campsite or storage lot, from winterizations, appliance repairs and system troubleshooting to full roof replacements and interior renovations. It also handles hydraulic and electronic leveling systems, slide room repair, solar, awnings, and hitch and base plate installation, and offers winter watch inspections.

coverage_quotes: RV Master Tech is a Cape Cod–based mobile RV service that brings professional repair, maintenance, and upgrades right to your home, campsite, or storage lot.

listings.d: On-Site Mobile RV Repair is a mobile RV repair service covering Massachusetts and Rhode Island, driving a fully equipped service vehicle to the customer's campsite, storage lot or driveway. coverage_quotes: Serving Massachusetts and Rhode Island — call to confirm coverage in your area.

It is based in Carver and covers Plymouth, Bristol and Barnstable counties including Middleborough, Bourne, New Bedford, Fall River, Yarmouth and Sandwich.

Its showroom stocks manufacturer-specific and special-order parts, hitches, lights, covers, plumbing, HVAC, electrical, bath, awnings and generators.
